## Combo 1698-3260-3540-6259
Cards: K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth + Pontiff of Blight + Mourning + Samut, the Driving Force
Color identity: BRGW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {B/P} plus either {W/B} or {B/P}
Produces: Near-infinite lifegain; Near-infinite lifeloss; Near-infinite lifegain triggers; Near-infinite storm count
Start: K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth (battlefield); Pontiff of Blight (battlefield); Mourning (hand); Samut, the Driving Force (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
  You have at least three opponents.
Steps: Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
  Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
  Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
  Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
  Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
  Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
  Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
Notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

Color identity: BRGW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinitely large creature until end of turn
Start: Darien, King of Kjeldor (battlefield); Havoc Jester (battlefield); Essence Warden (battlefield); Bloodthrone Vampire (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control another creature.
  You have 2 or more life.
Steps: Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
  When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
  Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
  When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
  Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
  Repeat.

Produces: Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Put all creature cards in your library onto the battlefield, then into your graveyard
Start: Atla Palani, Nest Tender (battlefield); Bloodflow Connoisseur (battlefield); Conspiracy (battlefield: with "Egg" chosen)
Prerequisites: You control another creature.
Steps: Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
  When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
  Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
  Repeat as desired / able.
Notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

Steps: Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg.
  When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
  Resolve the Yahenni ability.
  Repeat.
Notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

Color identity: BRGW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite power for a creature until end of turn; Put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield tapped
Start: Ghired, Mirror of the Wilds (battlefield); Atla Palani, Nest Tender (battlefield); Loot, the Anomaly (battlefield); Smellerbee, Rebel Fighter (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
  Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
  Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
  When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
  Repeat from step 2.

  Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

Color identity: BRGW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite scry 1; Put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield tapped
Start: Ghired, Mirror of the Wilds (battlefield); Atla Palani, Nest Tender (battlefield); Viscera Seer (battlefield); Fervor (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
  Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
  Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
  When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
  Repeat from step 2.

## Combo 3234-3293-3967-5226
Cards: Emeria Shepherd + World Shaper + Yahenni, Undying Partisan + Lithatog
Color identity: BRGW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite self-mill; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield; Infinitely large creature until end of turn
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Yahenni, Undying Partisan (battlefield); Lithatog (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Yahenni ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Color identity: BRGW | Bracket: Oddball | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{G}{G}{G}{G} at most
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite damage; Infinite death triggers; Infinite recursion of creature cards in your graveyard; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Preston, the Vanisher (battlefield); Goblin Bombardment (battlefield); Faceless Butcher (library); Nature's Rhythm (hand, graveyard)
Steps: Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.

  Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.

  When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.

## Combo 404-1251-1521-2105
Cards: Ghired, Conclave Exile + Combat Celebrant + Flamerush Rider + Dragonlord Kolaghan
Color identity: BRGW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite combat phases; Infinite copies of attacking creatures you control; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite tapped creature tokens; Infinite untap of creatures you control
Start: Ghired, Conclave Exile (battlefield); Combat Celebrant (battlefield); Flamerush Rider (battlefield); Dragonlord Kolaghan (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
  Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
  Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
  Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
  Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
  Repeat from step 4.
  Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

Steps: Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
  Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
  Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
  Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
  Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
  Repeat from step 4.
  Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.
